route.title: Assignments
route.description: The receivables assigned to your factor, what they still owe, and how their payments match.

title: Assignments
banner: An assignment covers a receivable that has already been invoiced. {{brand}} prepares the file and matches what the factor paid: sending it to the factor stays your move.
financeHidden: Per-assignment amounts are not shown: your role does not grant access to detailed financial data. Counts, statuses and the header totals stay readable.
loadError: Assignments could not be read. Try again in a moment.

contracts.title: Factoring contracts
contracts.empty: No factoring contract yet. Add your factor's contract to be able to assign a receivable.
contracts.bankNote: No bank details are asked for or kept: the factor's transfer lands in your own account, it never passes through here.

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.emptyWhy: An assignment is prepared from an invoiced, unpaid receivable, in the list below.
assignments.unknownAccount: No client attached to this mission
assignments.noRate: No rate on this assignment nor on its contract
assignments.markAssigned: Mark as sent to the factor
assignments.reject: The factor turned this receivable down
assignments.recall: The factor took this receivable back
assignments.closeTitle: Why is the factor handing this receivable back?
assignments.closeHint: Write down what the factor told you. Without that reason, nobody will know in six months why this receivable stayed on your books.

missing.title: No assignment
missing.hint: Invoiced, unpaid receivables that no assignment covers. Not all of them are meant to be assigned: this is a gap to look at, not a fault.
missing.empty: No invoiced receivable without an assignment.
missing.prepareHint: The file is prepared here; sending it to the factor stays your move.
missing.amountHint: Leave it empty if you do not know it yet: the screen will say so rather than show a zero.

settlements.title: Payments to match
settlements.hint: Payments from the factor that no assignment settles yet.
settlements.empty: Every payment received has been matched.
settlements.reconcileMenu: Match this payment to an assignment
settlements.noCandidate: No sent assignment to match against

toast.prepared: Assignment prepared. Send it to your factor, then come back and mark it sent.
toast.closed: The factor's decision has been recorded.
